title: Pagecast: a CLI that publishes your agent's HTML output straight to a live Cloudflare Pages URL
description:
Your agent generates an HTML report or a static mini-app, and it just sits on your disk as a file nobody else can see. Pagecast publishes it instantly to a shareable Cloudflare Pages URL, straight from your terminal or coding agent. Claude Code builds a dashboard, runs one command, hands you a live link hosted free on Cloudflare's edge. No git push, no deploy pipeline, no dashboard dragging. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/Amal-David/pagecast
